instruction.text: Here you can see four animals and their lengths in centimetres. Find the animal with the greatest length.
Select all the animals with lengths less than the buffalo’s length.

trainers.finishSound: The hyena and the dolphin are shorter than the buffalo.

instruction.text: Is the length of the hyena greater than or less than the dolphin?

instruction.text: Is the length of the buffalo greater than or less than the dolphin?

trainers.finishSound: The buffalo is longer than the dolphin.

instruction.text: Is the length of the buffalo greater than or less than the hippo?

trainers.finishSound: The buffalo is shorter than the hippo.
